proof_summary: For the auxiliary linear-recurrence sequence, the proof studies the quadratic remainder \(D_n=b_{n+1}^2-b_nb_{n+2}\), deriving \(D_{n+3}=4D_{n+1}+D_n\) and using positivity and growth bounds for \(b_n\) to show \(1\le D_n\le b_n\). Thus \(b_{n+1}^2=b_nb_{n+2}+D_n\) has remainder in exactly the range that makes \(\lceil b_{n+1}^2/b_n\rceil-1=b_{n+2}\), so induction identifies the originally defined sequence with the linear-recurrence sequence.
